note: The public address of the app. Change it with: python scripts/site.py set https://your-domain/ (see docs/product/HOSTING.md). 'footer' is the text printed at the bottom of kit cards, posters and the flyer instead of the address; remove it to print the address. 'indexnow_key' names app/<key>.txt, which proves to Bing's IndexNow that the deploy may announce changed pages (docs/product/SEO.md). 'adsense_client' (ca-pub-…) switches on Google AdSense on the guide pages (never in the app) and publishes ads.txt; leave it empty for no ads (docs/product/ADSENSE.md).
